title: TEPCO Begins 25th ALPS Treated Water Discharge (7th of FY2026)
detail: TEPCO began the seventh FY2026 round of ALPS-treated water discharge on October 26, 2026, the 25th since August 2023, scheduled to continue through November 13. TEPCO plans about 62,400 tons across eight rounds in the fiscal year ending March 2027.
